title: Mixed Event — Stream With Friends♡ Wedding Live! — Episode3 Dreamy Ceremonies

meta.Event Outline: Minori has started doing solo walking-tour streams as part of MORE MORE JUMP!'s activities. One day, she follows a viewer's recommendation to check out the Phoenix Bridal Fair!

rows.Line: Phoenix Bridal Fair Venue

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Sorry for the wait, everyone!
The stream's back up and running♪

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<There she is!>
<Welcome back.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks for waiting, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Guess what?! I've got some good news!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Good news?>
<Does it have to do with that girl you were talking to just now?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, it actually does!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You're not gonna believe this!
Today, we get to have one of the Phoenix Bridal Fair staff as our guide! Let's give Nene Kusanagi a big round of applause!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh... H-Hi...

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Oh, is this your friend?!>
<She'll be on your stream?!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
U-Umm...
Hello, viewers... My name is Nene Kusanagi...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-Thank you for having me on today...

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Your dress is so pretty!>
<Welcome aboard!>
<Wait, isn't she in WXS?!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. That's right. She's a member of Wonderlands×Showtime! They put on the night show that went viral a little while back!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: She's playing the lead in the wedding show that's taking place in the evening, so make sure to drop by the Phoenix Bridal Fair if you happen to be in the neighborhood!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I wanna see the show!>
<Does this mean you're gonna stream the show?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe. They all sound really excited!
Thanks again for doing this, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: R-Right. Of course...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, now that we're all set and ready to go, it's time to resume Minori's walk through the Phoenix Bridal Fair...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Alright, then...
Let's start with the train wedding booth.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, the train wedding...!
That was in the pamphlet! It takes place on a real one, right?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But how do you actually hold the ceremony...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
By renting out a part of a station.
You hold the ceremony aboard a train car or on the tracks.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Apparently, the platform signs and line names are all specially designed for the wedding, so it's supposed to be a really memorable experience.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
The platform signs...?
Does that mean you can have the train headed for the “Paradise of Love” and stuff?! If so, that would be really memorable...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I-I'm not sure about that...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Also, the wedding taking place on a train means...

rows.Speaker: Announcement
rows.Line: <The train carrying the bride will be arriving on this platform shortly. Please stand behind the yellow line for your own safety.>
se_event_wedding_2024_001
se_event_wedding_2024_002

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you all for coming today!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I hope you'll all give me a warm welcome when I arrive at the station of Eternal Happiness.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Harukaaa...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh?!
H-Hanasato?! Is something wrong?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-The thought of Haruka being aboard that train almost made my heart explode...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
O-Oh, okay...
You really surprised me there.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<That's our Minori for you.>
<Always on the Haruka hype train.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Everyone watching seems totally fine with this. I guess this is how she always is...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. Sorry, everyone. I really can't help myself...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But how amazing would it be to have the station announce that the bride is arriving on the platform?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Everyone would toss flower petals into the air as she steps out of the train.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And she'd step back onto the train after its destination changes to the “Future”! Wouldn't that be so romantic?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Your imagination's very specific...

rows.Speaker: Booth Attendant
rows.Line:
I see...
That certainly would be fun.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Booth Attendant
rows.Line:
Oh, pardon me.
I'm in charge of this booth, and I gave what you just said a little thought...

rows.Speaker: Booth Attendant
rows.Line: The train displays and announcements can be changed easily enough, so your idea may be worth trying.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
R-Really?!
I'm glad to hear that what I said helped!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: H-Her delusion ended up contributing...!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Nice work!>
<Way to go, Minori!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks for the praise.
But I have Haruka to thank for this...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm not sure how much credit Kiritani deserves...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But she seems happy enough. I guess it doesn't matter.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Anyway, next booth!
Let's keep checking out as much as we can!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, for the aquarium wedding, you rent out a part of it in order to hold the ceremony.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Like in the underwater tunnel.
You can even have the dolphins jump out of the water when the bride and groom appear together. There really are a lot of fun options to choose from...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow...!
This picture of the underwater tunnel's so pretty!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Just look at how the water's sparkling...
This looks like the perfect place for someone like Shizuku to get married!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Shizuku under the sea?!>
<She'd be like a mermaid or undine...>
<I'd love to see that! Even if it means my eyes melting away!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You guys get it!
Oh, I know! I should try to see if I can do a stream with Shizuku at the aquarium...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Next, we have the great outdoors.
You can hold weddings at campground and forest spaces that you've rented out.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You get to pitch tents, have a big barbeque and enjoy the things that only the natural world has to offer.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
A big barbeque...!
That'd suit Airi so well!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: R-Really?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I don't know how, but she's able to roast any type of meat just right!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, after the sun's gone down, and everyone's had their stomachs filled...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Airi would appear while holding a candle, and thank everyone for coming to her wedding, while blushing a little...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh...
That would be pretty nice.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<No! You're making me tear up!>
<Congratulations, Airi.>
<I wanna watch over Airi forever as one of the cedar trees!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
See what I mean?!
Does this mean I have some natural talent as a wedding planner...?!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<No, an actual planner would need to be able to keep it together.>
<You'd end up crying more than the families involved.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: N-No, that's not true!!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Hanasato really seems to be enjoying herself...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Not only that...)

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I didn't know weddings came in so many shapes and sizes.>
<The Bridal Fair looks really fun!>
<I wanna go too!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Her viewers also seem to be interested in the fair itself.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I really wasn't sure about this at first, but I'm glad I decided to help...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Hehe...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Nene seems to be enjoying herself very much♪)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Talking about these wonderful wedding ideas seems to have eased her anxiety... And I like how... Mhm...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
(Zzz... Zzz...♪
I can probably sleep like a baby right now...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Anyway, where should we go next?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I dunno. Every area looks like a lot of fun... No, wait!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I've got it!
We should totally go here next!
